title: GET /api/share/:token — public read-only project data endpoint
description: Public endpoint (no auth required) that returns project data for the read-only share page. Returns only publicly-shareable fields.
acceptanceCriteria: Returns 404 if token is invalid or project is_public = false
Returns: project (name, type, status, vision, progress, points, level), milestones, todos, journal entries, recent timeline events
Does NOT return: AI chat history, parking lot items, github_access_token, user email

steps.details: Create server/src/routes/publicShare.ts. GET /:token (no requireAuth): 1) Find project WHERE share_token = token AND is_public = true. If not found, return 404. 2) Fetch milestones, todos, journal_entries (WHERE deleted_at IS NULL), and last 50 timeline events. 3) Return 200 with { project: { id, name, type, description, status, progressAuto, progressManual, pointsTotal, level, createdAt }, milestones, todos, journalEntries, timeline }.
In index.ts, mount WITHOUT requireAuth: app.use('/api/share', publicShareRouter).
Enable sharing, GET /api/share/:token without any auth headers — verify 200 with project data. Try invalid token — expect 404. Try token of private project — expect 404.

technicalNotes: This endpoint bypasses requireAuth — make sure it's mounted before the requireAuth middleware in index.ts
Carefully select what to return — do NOT include sensitive user data or encrypted tokens
